data.narrative:
NextSilicon, an AI & Software company at Series B led by Elad Raz, has raised $200M+ to date. Valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 9 private firms and 1 public company (Palantir, ticker PLTR). Direct Stage B peers include Scale AI ($29.0B), Physical Intelligence ($5.6B), and Black Forest Labs ($3.2B).

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses total capital raised ($200M) as a proxy base value and applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical for Series B advancement, implying a $380M valuation. Peer-median analysis across the three same-sector, same-stage comparables yields a $5.6B median valuation, with a range spanning $3.2B to $29.0B. The peer-median method carries greater weight given direct stage and sector alignment.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $323M (low) to $6.4B (high), with a median of $3.0B. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty in market positioning relative to scale leaders like Scale AI versus smaller cohort members. Key unknowns include customer concentration, recurring revenue mix, and capital efficiency relative to peers. The $3.0B–$5.6B band represents the most defensible range absent material new data on revenue traction or customer concentration.
